title: frame-script mini-compiler: gotoAndStop/Play by label and nextFrame/prevFrame actions
description:
The frame-script mini-compiler in packages/swf/src/actions.ts (compileFrameScript) only handles gotoAndStop(N) and gotoAndPlay(N) with integer frame numbers, emitting ActionGotoFrame (0x81). It does NOT handle:

  - gotoAndStop('labelName')  / gotoAndPlay('labelName')  → must emit ActionGotoFrame2 (0x9F) with a push + GotoFrame2 record
  - nextFrame() / prevFrame()  → ActionNextFrame (0x04) / ActionPrevFrame (0x05)
  - nextScene() / prevScene()  → push scene name + ActionGotoExpression (multi-step)

This is a real authoring gap: nearly all Flash tutorials use named labels for navigation (stop(); on frame 'end'; gotoAndStop('game') from a button). Currently the compiler silently skips these lines (the 'unknown line: skip' path), so the published SWF does nothing on those frames.

Work items:
1. Add nextFrame() → ActionNextFrame (0x04, no-payload).
2. Add prevFrame() → ActionPrevFrame (0x05, no-payload).
3. Add gotoAndStop('label') / gotoAndPlay('label') → ActionPush string + ActionGotoFrame2 (0x9F) with PlayFlag bit 0 set/clear. ActionGotoFrame2 flags = 0x01 for play, 0x00 for stop (per CLAUDE.md AVM1 notes: 'PlayFlag is bit 0, not bit 1').
4. Add unit tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/ that verify the emitted byte sequences against opcode values from ruffle/swf/src/avm1/opcode.rs.
5. Extend ActionsPanel snippet list (packages/authoring-ui/src/ActionsPanel.tsx) to include nextFrame/prevFrame/gotoAndStop('label') snippets.

Acceptance: a document with a frame labeled 'game' and a stop() frame script that transitions via gotoAndStop('game') from a button compiles and navigates correctly in Ruffle (E2E or visual-oracle test).
